name: table-row-height
description: A single table row beside a vertical measurement arrow.
useCase: Adjust the height of selected table rows.
misuse: Give the control an accessible name that specifies the table action.

16.reason: Two adjoining cells identify one row. Open cell counters and shallow complete arrowheads keep the dimension clear at text size.

24.reason: Both row edges align with the vertical arrowheads, and the two open cells retain clear counters.
